messages:
Elena (CEO): Thanks everyone for a great all-hands today — really appreciated the thoughtful Qs. Posting a quick follow-up thread with links and owners so things don't get lost. Recording: https://redwood.ai/allhands/2026-03-22 Recording (passcode: redwood). Slides: https://drive.google.com/redwood-allhands-0326
Devon (VP Product): For the roadmap Q — short recap: Dedicated capacity improvements (latency SLOs) are our top engineering bet for H2; Private deployment onboarding and audit logs are the parallel enterprise focus. We'll publish a more detailed timeline next week.
Jorge (PM): Action item: I'll publish the detailed roadmap doc (owner: @Jorge) by Tue 03/30. Link will include migration paths for customers on Hosted -> Dedicated.
Marcus (Eng Manager): Re latency targets: we committed to P95 < 70ms for small-gen on Dedicated nodes. Working on perf PRs this sprint. I'll add a small RFC for kernel selection heuristics.
Priya (SRE): Ops note: we'll run a Dedicated resilience exercise week of 04/12. If you have customer-facing routes that rely on Dedicated, please @Priya so we can include them in the playbook.
Ava (Design): Asked about console UX improvements — we'll do two incremental flows (rollout config & route tracing) and ship the rollout config UI in v0.9. Owner: @Ava, ETA end-April.
Sam (Data Scientist): Question from the Q&A: will we expose eval telemetry to customers? Short answer: yes, opt-in telemetry for quality alerts — security review in progress.
Marcus (Eng Manager): Quick clarification on model fallbacks: Hosted will prefer cheaper variants automatically; Dedicated customers can opt out. We'll add clearer docs.
Elena (CEO): On pricing: no immediate changes for hosted pricing right now — we want to stabilize unit economics before changing tiers. If you're working on pricing experiments, coordinate with finance and @Elena.
Jorge (PM): FYI — I captured the top 6 customer asks from the session: private network setup, audit logs, rollout controls, model quantization guidance, tooling for cost insights, longer observability retention. I'll put that in the roadmap doc.
Devon (VP Product): Two clarifications requested in Slack: 1) Can Dedicated auto-scale cross-region? Short: not in the first wave — multi-region Dedicated is a follow-on. 2) Will there be a migration tool for embeddings? Yes, we'll publish a migration guide and a small helper script.
Priya (SRE): If anyone sees the deploy-bot alert (deploy-bot): "smoke failure on canary-3" — that's related to autoscaler tweaks; @Marcus and I are on it.
Marcus (Eng Manager): Update: looking now, seems a config mismatch. Will revert the autoscaler patch if not green in 20m.
Ava (Design): Quick link to prototype for rollout UI: https://figma.com/file/redwood-rollout-ux — comments welcome.
Jorge (PM): Request: if you asked a question during the all-hands and I didn't follow up directly, please drop the question reply here or DM me. I'll triage and add owners.
Elena (CEO): Final ask: leadership will do a 30-min AMA next Thursday at 11am PT for any remaining questions. Put questions here or add to the shared doc: https://docs.google.com/redwood-allhands-ama.
Sam (Data Scientist): Minor note: recorded timestamp on the video is off by 1hr — engineering/infra to fix post-processing.
Marcus (Eng Manager): I'll open a short PR with the perf numbers we referenced in slides and link it here once merged.
Devon (VP Product): TL;DR action list (copied for clarity):

- @Jorge -> publish detailed roadmap doc (03/30)
- @Marcus -> perf RFC + PR (this sprint)
- @Ava -> rollout UI prototype feedback (end-April)
- @Priya -> include routes in Dedicated resilience exercise (04/12)
- @Sam -> follow up on recording timestamp issue
- @Elena/@Devon -> schedule AMA (11am PT Thu)

Please react with :white_check_mark: when you've read/acked your item.
Elena (CEO): Thanks again — feeling optimistic about the focus. Ping me or leadership if anything urgent comes up. :sparkles:
